motivation: Fresh held-out memory gaze/fire models lost a base3 goal through prolonged contact loss. Test TRAIN movement causal signal before any new architecture fitting; source gaze and fire remain intact.
selection: First2 future streams select by mean alive-goal, then mean kills, then observed full-task utility4*goal+.25*kills-received/100-death. Fixed label order for ties. Third stream excluded from selection. Alive unfinished is censored; no invented terminal outcome or post-limit survival reward.
controls: Full strict nofork/source, zero-fork/reference, fork-prefix/root/category/draw and intervention-window audits. One nofork per world, fork-only reference plus control each stream, plus only the frozen selected action if noncontrol. No tail supplement, seed replacement or further action search.
interpretation: 4 dependent TRAIN-world conditional repeats, not policy superiority. Full capture controls required. Reacquisition timing descriptive only; full task outcomes govern scaling.
